timeline.summary: Lehar Footwears reported Q1FY27 standalone revenue of ₹74.95 Cr, down 47.3% YoY, with PAT of ₹3.01 Cr, and appointed Rajesh Gattani as CFO effective 15 September 2026.
Lehar Footwears commenced operations at new sports shoes manufacturing facility in Kundli, Haryana, expanding capacity by 150% to 2.5 lakh pairs per month.

Lehar Footwears Ltd held its 32nd AGM on September 10, 2026, chaired by Mr. Raj Kumar Agarwal, Chairman & Whole Time Director, with Ms. Ritika Poddar, Company Secretary & Compliance Officer, presiding over proceedings.

Lehar Footwears Ltd’s AGM on September 10, 2026, passed all resolutions unanimously, including audited financials, ₹0.50 dividend, and reappointing Mr. Naresh Kumar Agarwal (DIN: 00106649) as director.
Lehar Footwears disclosed CRISIL reaffirmation of credit rating at ₹105 Cr bank facilities (up from ₹78 Cr) with stable outlook
